categories.main_business_segments: China Pacific Insurance (Group) Co., Ltd. (CPIC) operates primarily in life and health insurance, property and casualty insurance, specialized health insurance, pension products and services, and asset management. Its subsidiaries include CPIC Life, CPIC P/C, CPIC Health, CPIC AMC, Changjiang Pension, CPIC Capital, and CPIC Fund, covering a broad spectrum of insurance and financial services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: CPIC leverages advanced digital technologies including big data governance, AI, Internet of Things (IoT), and large model-driven digital employees to enhance risk management, customer service, claims processing, and marketing. It has developed proprietary platforms such as the Di08-4 Smart Claims Service Platform and the Zhuo’er e+ smart pension service system, integrating AI, OCR, and real-time data analytics to optimize operations and customer experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CPIC serves individual and institutional customers across China, including mid-tier, high-end, and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. It also targets corporate clients, government-sponsored insurance programs, and strategic accounts in sectors like technology, agriculture, and emerging industries. The company supports rural households, new energy vehicle owners, and provides inclusive insurance products for low-income groups and new forms of employment.
categories.geographic_coverage: CPIC primarily operates in Mainland China with significant presence in economically developed and populous regions such as Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Shanghai, Beijing, and others. It also has operations in Hong Kong through CPIC Life (HK) and maintains overseas business via CPIC HK. The company is expanding its international footprint, leveraging Hong Kong as a gateway for overseas networks and investments.
categories.supply_chain_position: CPIC operates primarily downstream in the insurance value chain, providing insurance products and services directly to customers. It also manages asset portfolios and third-party assets, acting as an asset manager. The company engages in risk protection, claims management, and pension fund management, positioning itself as an integrated insurer with comprehensive service offerings rather than upstream manufacturing or raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include digital transformation with AI and big data, development of smart digital employees, innovation in health and elderly care insurance products, green insurance and investment, and expansion of pension finance services. CPIC emphasizes building a digital and intelligent ecosystem, enhancing customer resource management, and integrating technology with insurance to drive high-quality growth and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: CPIC generates revenue primarily through insurance premiums from life, health, property and casualty insurance products. It also earns income from asset management fees, investment income, and health management service fees. The company’s revenue streams include product sales, service fees, investment returns, and commissions from diversified distribution channels such as agency, bancassurance, and group channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CPIC is ranked as the 3rd largest insurer in China for both life and property and casualty insurance by primary premium income. It holds a strong market position with industry-leading digital capabilities and comprehensive product offerings. The company competes with other major Chinese insurers and international players, leveraging innovation, customer service, and ESG leadership to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CPIC reported group operating income of RMB404.089 billion, a 24.7% increase year-on-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB44.960 billion, up 64.9%. The group’s assets under management reached RMB3.543 trillion, growing 21.2%. Embedded value increased by 6.2% to RMB562.066 billion. The company demonstrated steady growth in new business value, premiums, and investment yields, reflecting robust financial scale and positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CPIC emphasizes responsible, smart, and caring services, integrating insurance with technology to offer innovative, customer-centric solutions. Its value proposition includes comprehensive risk protection, digital and AI-enabled efficient claims processing, smart pension services, and green insurance products. The company differentiates itself through advanced digital transformation, large-scale deployment of digital employees, strong ESG commitments, and tailored products addressing diverse customer needs across life stages and industries.
